name: Solar Opposites
description: A family of aliens from a much better world must take refuge in middle America after the destruction of their planet. Their mission: protect the Pupa, a living super computer that will one day evolve into its true form, consume them and terraform the Earth.

videos.title: A Very Solar Holiday Opposites Special
videos.overview: HO HO HO! The Solars don't understand the holidays, but that won't stop them from trying!

videos.overview: Sometimes alien life can be spooky. The Solar Opposites do a Halloween Special!
